msg: The 1.5 seconds you get to make your decision in terms of the choice of gnomes is no time at all, so it's really important you remain aware and alert. Also ensure your fingers are poised above the keys S and K and also the space bar.I found that the amount of mushrooms really varied massively throughout the game, even when concentrating on and selecting specific coloured gnomes.The purple, dark pink, brown and green gnomes seemed to work well for me in terms of the amount of mushrooms, however they did vary throughout the game.The most important thing is to remain alert, don't take your eye off the screen, make sure your fingers are above the keys you need to press and make sure you take full advantage of the breaks.
